new.en: Faber tells you once when a big job is finished or needs you.
new.pt-BR: O Faber avisa uma vez quando um trabalho grande termina ou precisa de você.
new.es: Faber te avisa una vez cuando un trabajo grande termina o te necesita.
new.fr: Faber vous prévient une fois quand un gros travail est fini ou a besoin de vous.
new.de: Faber sagt dir einmal Bescheid, wenn eine große Arbeit fertig ist oder dich braucht.

decisions: | R-next | 2026-10-30 | A project agent that started other conversations and ends its run on a closing box that is done or asks the person tells the tray once ("{title}: done, come and look", "{title}: needs a decision from you"), through the same notice Keep going uses when it stops, only once none of its members is still working. A member never notifies; a reply Keep going already stopped on is not told twice; each box is told once (in memory, so a restart never repeats an old one). Notifications on/off and R92's delivery rules cover it; no setting of its own. | AI (Erick delegou) |
